### 2026-10-11 – Since this was my first time, I had to download both Github and KiCad. I ran into my first problem when trying to add in the XIAO ESP32-C3. It wouldn't appear at all so I googled it and it told me to

**3h**

Since this was my first time, I had to download both Github and KiCad. I ran into my first problem when trying to add in the XIAO ESP32-C3. It wouldn't appear at all so I googled it and it told me to download the seeed files and a ton of other stuff. So, I downloaded it and it just gave me a ton of error. I might be because my PC is older an dhas very limited stoarage but i ended up not being able to import anything at all  after clicking A. I searched it up some more and i had to do a reset and ended up importing a huge error and nothing was working out at all my global library was empty and my files were in the right format so i also had to do some conversion there.
